title: The Proton Radius Puzzle
html:
Remark. The Proton Radius Puzzle

The proton charge radius differs when measured in muonic versus electronic hydrogen. We trace this discrepancy to generation-dependent substrate couplings. Lepton generations correspond to the vertical degree of the Reeb decomposition (Descartes leptons). Each generation couples to the substrate parameter q (substrate parameter) through a distinct vertical harmonic form. This coupling modifies the effective electromagnetic interaction between the proton and the orbiting lepton. The q-correction depends on the lepton generation. The measured charge radius differs by an amount of order \hbar_q (quantum planck constant). This difference provides a direct test of the Reeb decomposition.
